# Scope: a character. Changes their ideology to $FAITH$ (no crypto-believers) and moves their wing to match.
wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { faith = $FAITH$ } }
		set_variable = { name = forbid_crypto_reconversion value = yes days = 30 }
		set_character_faith = $FAITH$
		wm_ideo_resync_wing_effect = yes
	}
}

# Scope: a character whose ideology changed. A Labour or Conservative MP with a wing moves to their new
# ideology's wing (wm_wing_effects.txt).
wm_ideo_resync_wing_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = wm_wing }
		wm_wing_leave_effect = yes
		wm_ideo_wing_effect = yes
	}
}

# Scope: a Labour or Conservative MP without a wing. Joins their ideology's wing (or the nearest in their
# party); with no political ideology ("Not Stated") they get none here (wm_wing_assign_effect picks one).
wm_ideo_wing_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_labour }
		if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_socialist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 1 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_social_democrat }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 2 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_green }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 2 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_liberal }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_centrist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_cross_community }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_one_nation }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_free_market }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_national_conservative }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_populist_right }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_scottish_nationalist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 2 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_welsh_nationalist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 2 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_irish_republican }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 2 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_irish_nationalist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 2 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_unionist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 3 LEAN = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:wm_party ?= title:k_party_conservative }
		if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_socialist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_social_democrat }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_green }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_liberal }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_centrist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_cross_community }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_one_nation }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_free_market }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 5 LEAN = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_national_conservative }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 6 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_populist_right }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 6 LEAN = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_scottish_nationalist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_welsh_nationalist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_irish_republican }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_irish_nationalist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 4 LEAN = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { faith = faith:wm_ideo_unionist }
			wm_wing_join_effect = { WING = 5 LEAN = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# The month for ideology (run by wm_polls_monthly_effect). Seats drift: each month a seat may convert to its MP's
# ideology, or (in Great Britain) to the mainstream ideology of the party leading the national polls. Low public
# trust and riots make both likelier (wm_ideo_values.txt). One pass over the seats, a few cheap checks each.
wm_ideo_monthly_effect = {
	wm_ideo_national_lead_effect = yes
	every_county = {
		limit = {
			exists = holder
			holder = { wm_is_mp_trigger = yes }
		}
		save_temporary_scope_as = wm_ideo_seat
		if = {
			limit = { wm_ideo_seat_can_follow_mp_trigger = yes }
			random = {
				chance = wm_ideo_seat_drift_mp_chance_value
				wm_ideo_seat_convert_effect = { FAITH = scope:wm_ideo_seat.holder.faith }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { wm_ideo_seat_can_follow_nation_trigger = yes }
			random = {
				chance = wm_ideo_seat_drift_national_chance_value
				wm_ideo_seat_convert_effect = { FAITH = global_var:wm_ideo_national_faith }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a seat (county title). Converts to $FAITH$.
wm_ideo_seat_convert_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = forbid_crypto_reconversion value = yes days = 30 }
	set_county_faith = $FAITH$
}

# The mainstream ideology of the party leading the Great Britain-wide polls: global_var:wm_ideo_national_faith.
wm_ideo_national_lead_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_lead value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_lab
			global_var:wm_poll_lab > global_var:wm_ideo_national_lead
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_lead value = global_var:wm_poll_lab }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_faith value = faith:wm_ideo_social_democrat }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_con
			global_var:wm_poll_con > global_var:wm_ideo_national_lead
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_lead value = global_var:wm_poll_con }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_faith value = faith:wm_ideo_one_nation }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_ld
			global_var:wm_poll_ld > global_var:wm_ideo_national_lead
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_lead value = global_var:wm_poll_ld }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_faith value = faith:wm_ideo_liberal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_ruk
			global_var:wm_poll_ruk > global_var:wm_ideo_national_lead
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_lead value = global_var:wm_poll_ruk }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_faith value = faith:wm_ideo_populist_right }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_poll_grn
			global_var:wm_poll_grn > global_var:wm_ideo_national_lead
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_lead value = global_var:wm_poll_grn }
		set_global_variable = { name = wm_ideo_national_faith value = faith:wm_ideo_green }
	}
}

# Change Your Politics (wm_ideo_decisions.txt): the ideology picked in the decision's list.
wm_ideo_change_chosen_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_socialist ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_socialist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_social_democrat ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_social_democrat }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_green ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_green }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_liberal ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_liberal }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_centrist ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_centrist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_cross_community ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_cross_community }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_one_nation ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_one_nation }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_free_market ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_free_market }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_national_conservative ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_national_conservative }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_populist_right ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_populist_right }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_scottish_nationalist ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_scottish_nationalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_welsh_nationalist ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_welsh_nationalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_irish_republican ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_irish_republican }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_irish_nationalist ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_irish_nationalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_ideo_pick_unionist ?= yes }
		wm_ideo_set_faith_effect = { FAITH = faith:wm_ideo_unionist }
	}
}
